scenes.say: Appa keeps wiping his glasses, but everything still looks hazy.

scenes.en: Glare and halos around lights at night.
scenes.say: At night, lights look too bright, with glare around them.

scenes.en: With age, the clear lens inside the eye slowly turns cloudy.
scenes.say: These can be signs of cataract. With age, the clear lens inside the eye slowly turns cloudy.

scenes.en: Faded colours. Glasses power changing often. Double vision in one eye.
scenes.say: Other signs: colours look faded, the glasses power keeps changing, or double vision in one eye.

scenes.en: Book an eye test for your parents.
scenes.say: So his daughter booked him an eye test. If you notice these signs in your parents, don't ignore them.

scenes.en: An eye specialist can advise the right treatment.
scenes.say: Get their eyes checked, and see an eye specialist, who can advise the right treatment at the right time.
